intent: absolute_characterization; prior direct-Envoy, AGW, aggregate, and prototype runs are contextual, not same-series references

execution.aiperf_version_resolution: Reference-reproduction exception: frozen Claude/prototype and paired gateway replays pin 0.12.0. The latest stable release was resolved as 0.13.0 on 2026-09-26, but its single-manager Mooncake preparation failed before measurement in this campaign.

quality_gates: One active gateway; six clients on pinned nodes; zero errors/cancellations; exact dataset hashes; full Mooncake trace and mmap cache hits; selected decode Pod clusters match Ready Pods
comparison_limit: Summary-level characterization has no per-request common-window count or merged percentiles. Different benchmark series and possible start/occupancy differences prevent promotion-grade direct deltas against older gateway results. Synthetic workers do not measure GPU inference or NIXL.
